author: NewVoltdrive
body:
Let's start with the most. (Note: No offense to you map creators that got a spot on the bottom, just my opinion.)

My top 5 favorite Nebula maps!

5. Curbituar. Author: Merlinmaster
This map is reminiscent of the MC Zone map style IMO. And it really does it well. The middle prevents stalemates, and it is easy to rush despite the monument placement. Thank you jozz.

4. Rendezvous. Author: ParaPenguin (I think, correct me if I'm wrong.)
This map is very simple. It looks like 2 Under Armour logos. But, it is really well gameplay, and the community needs to make more maps like these. (And the map devs need to accept more of these.)

3. Justice 2. Author: Evocal
Speaking of Rendezvous, this is IMO an upgrade to Rendezvous that does it Justice. (See what I did there.) Wider areas, a bit more detailing, and different monument placement, it really hits the spot.

2. Venomous DTM. Author: G_SKIPPY
Although I like the TDM version too, I prefer the DTM version. It isn't too easy, but not too hard to rush, lots of PVP, and it has a great terrain. G_SKIPPY, you are just amazing.

1. Castle Adventure Author: Jessemania (I think?)
This map is just perfect. Despite it's girly appearance, it's gameplay is well designed, and it is pretty good looking too. My favorite part about this map is that it is very customizable in it's gameplay. Want a brawl? Sure. Want a bow-off? Can do. Want rushers? It can do that. Just. Perfect.

Now for my least favorites.

5. Broken World/Ages. Author: World: Shirokamii, Ages: Cezbla
This map has way too much void, too plain, the monuments are hard to get to, and overall just badly designed. World and Ages are in the same slot because I consider them to be the same map.
4. Diamond Shore. Author: I think it was either Cobalt or AwarriorVenom, not sure.
This is the only map where I, for the life of me, CAN'T FIND THE MONUMENTS. It's way too confusing, the diamonds are too plentiful, and is kind of stalematey. Sorry, but 95% aesthetics, 5% gameplay.

3. Frostbite. Author: G_SKIPPY
IMO, this is the only map that Skippy has ever made that I hated. The diamonds are still too plentiful. (Even after Evo removed most of them.)
And it is way too frigging long. The average Frostbite match is about 45 minutes, if not longer.

2. Titans. Author: I'm not sure, either Skippy or ParaPenguin.
I hated this map before the XP change. But now that you have to get the XP via bottles, it is dreadful. Way too hard to kill someone, and so many people steal your XP. I have stopped enchanting my stuff. The PVP sucks, people always run away. Just. Bad.

1. Steampunk. Author: Sistahood (Most of them, anyway.)
When I played this map the first time, I thought it was dreadful. I couldn't find the monument for 10 minutes, and the gameplay is way too stalematey. It was easily trollable, and it is impossible for rushers. When it broke the first time, and they had to remove it, I was so relieved. They put it back again in Avicore.....and it was removed again. So, it really isn't even all that functional.

So, those were my top 5 most and least favorite Nebula maps. Here were my honorable and dishonorable mentions.
Honorable Mentions:
Actrix
Unix
Fissura
Dust Devils

Dishonorable Mentions:
Bleened Rings
Spookghetti
Halcyon (I removed CandylandDTM.)
Luar
EDIT: Fantasy (Current Version)
Thanks for reading.
